en: Make Claudia angry and you'll be sorry!
Oh, I hate it, hate it, hate it, hate it...
Huh? Oh, I wondered who it was.
Good day, Claudia.
You're looking well. By the way
<Do you dislike the washing?>
<Is the washing hard work?>
Daft! You think I do this for fun?
It's my job, that's why. I need the money.
Why else would I wash other folks' clothes?
Listen, it's not just the master's shirts,
there's the baby's nappies too!
It must be hard. I asked so thoughtlessly,
and I'm very sorry. Well, then
(Humans do nothing but work. How hard...)
Well, never mind. Watch me wash, then.
Get yourself a hardworking wife too.
It's grim, thinking this is my whole life...
Oh, I'm tired, so tired...
Mmm... I've had it with this job
Talking about work even in her dreams...?
You must be worn out by your daily toil.
I'm sorry, but please work a little longer,
for my own selfish ends
Eek
I must settle this quickly
I humbly await your orders
Oh dear, I feel rather tired
and I have work to do
Obeying my master's orders is my joy
Somehow my arms and legs are covered in cuts
How strange. What could have happened
Oh... excuse me, you there
Who are you? You can't just walk in here.
Are you here to see the master or mistress?
Hmm, it seems I have the wrong house.
And you, young lady?
Why would you want to know my name?
It's... Maud.
Um
I'm a wet nurse here.
If you've no business here, please leave.
Oh... it's you.
Do you want something with us servants?
If I talk too much, the master and
mistress will scold me... Excuse me.
If you've no business, please leave
You've come again
I can't understand how rich people think
You must live such a happy life
, it's you...
I keep intruding on you. Am I a nuisance?
No, not really... It's no bother.
Tell me... you are still young.
So why work here as a live-in wet nurse,
of all things?
Oh... well... um
I lost my baby soon after giving birth
and I still had milk, so luckily this job
The pay is good and the work is easy, but
sometimes I get so unbearably sad
It's far easier than the other servants' work,
so some here don't think well of me
A hard life.
(Hmph, humans are such bothersome things.)
I'm well too, thank you.
No, it's nothing.
What is it?
Um... who are you?
I don't much like talking with strangers
...I'm sorry. Excuse me.
Oh, um... what can I do for you?
H-hello
Um, are you keeping well?
<No>
I see. I'm glad you're well
Oh... please do take care of yourself.
There must be people who'd grieve for you
Do you really enjoy talking with me?
Why do you keep coming to see me?
